function.name: search_announcements
function.description: Search recent school announcements. Use this whenever the user asks about announcements, notices, or news from an office.

query.description: Keywords to search for in announcement titles and text. Must not be empty. At most 200 characters. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

days.description: How many days back to look, by publication date. Whole number from 1 to 30. Default 7.

limit.description: Maximum number of announcements to return. Whole number from 1 to 10. Default 5.
